decisions.reason: The rye country bread rests directly on the firm's core rye baking know-how, so the firm can easily read customer demand for it and refine it at low cost.
The premium raisin stollen is the firm's flagship and has repeatedly won the German Bread Institute's gold medal, which shows full mastery of the product and strong seasonal value.
The seeded rye mixed bread is a close variant of the existing bread range and fits current processes, so keeping it costs little and its results are easy to interpret.
The dark barley malt rye bread draws on established rye expertise, but with no reported results it remains the bread most exposed to range trimming.
The marzipan stollen sits beside the award-winning stollen line and uses the same confectionery know-how and seasonal gift demand.
The ancient grain bread, presented as the newest masterpiece, builds on the firm's grain expertise and fits the demand for traditional, natural products, so management keeps giving it time.
